# Bruno Moya

> I turn emerging technology into real products. Technical founder · AR hardware and agentic AI · Founder at Glassear · CTO at TopBrokers, based in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

Bruno Moya is a technical founder and software engineer based in Barcelona. Founder and CEO of Glassear and CTO at TopBrokers. His work spans AR hardware, XR software, AI agents and production infrastructure. This personal portfolio documents his contribution, engineering decisions and journey as a founder.

## Full profile

- [Everything as plain text](https://brunomoya.com/llms-full.txt): what he is building, milestones, awards, talks, press, experience, projects, education and skills in one file.
- [Structured professional profile](https://brunomoya.com/profile.json): the same information as JSON.

## Pages

- [Resume](https://brunomoya.com/#experience): career summary, also as [Markdown](https://brunomoya.com/resume.md) and [PDF](https://brunomoya.com/cv-english.pdf?v=20261024).
- [Projects](https://brunomoya.com/#projects): selected work, also as [Markdown](https://brunomoya.com/projects.md).
- [JobAgent - Autonomous AI Job Search & Application System](https://brunomoya.com/#projects): I use JobAgent to manage my own job search.
- [TalentGapAnalyzer - AI Workforce Intelligence](https://brunomoya.com/#projects): Winner - UAB The Hack 2025
- [How I am building Glassear Studio](https://glassear.com/studio/): A fully agentic platform where official coding agents build, test and fix interactive XR apps across a web IDE, a WebXR simulator and the Unity runtime.
- [MapAnim — Route Motion Studio](https://brunomoya.com/#projects): An interactive route-animation editor combining itinerary editing, camera controls, map styling and a frame-by-frame export pipeline.

The landing is also available as Markdown: /index.md in Spanish and /en/index.md in English.
Send `Accept: text/markdown` to either landing URL for its Markdown representation.
Project and experience links point to sections of the landing or the official product site.
